run_extract_sunrgbd_data: extract SUN RGB-D scene point clouds and bounding boxes from an index file to an output folder
run_data_viz: visualize SUN RGB-D data by projecting depth points onto images and drawing 2D and 3D bounding boxes
run_compute_median_size: compute median 3D bounding box sizes for each object class in the SUN RGB-D dataset
run_gen_v1_data: generate SUN RGB-D V1 dataset with 50k point clouds, bounding boxes, and ground truth votes
run_gen_v2_data: generate SUN RGB-D V2 dataset with 50k point clouds, bounding boxes, and ground truth votes
